title: Integration Rejection Record
$comment: DEC-2026-0043: an Integrator rejection is a first-class queue signal, not a report nobody reads. A record conforming to this schema suppresses its exact bundle's Integrator item and creates one Reviewer remediation item, so every field a queue decision rests on is required and checksummed. A record that does not conform is diagnostic and suppresses nothing: a malformed rejection must never be able to retire integration work.

rejectedBundle.$comment: The bundle, the Review that approved it, and the GUP it carries, each pinned by checksum. Naming them without checksums would let a record keep suppressing integration after the artifacts it describes had been re-issued.

blocking_failures.$comment: At least one machine-readable failure. A rejection with no stated failing check states no repairable defect, so it cannot direct remediation.
